name: SIC_ST_IDLE
meaning: update NORMAL; anchors Sheep on top

name: SIC_ST_SLIDING
meaning: kicked/bumped: 800 u/s along slideDir until a wall (one bounce) or the edge of pushBoxes

name: SIC_ST_FALLING
meaning: after msg 5 drop: falls (crushing), sinks in water with the splash, then msg 0x36 to FrozenRiver

name: SIC_ST_RIVER_SLIDE
meaning: landed from state 2 outside water: slides toward -z up to 800 u/s (crushing); airborne for 0x200 ticks gives state 2
